segments.thag21.1:3.3: Neva maṃ byādhayissanti [byāthayissanti (?)], dhamme samhi [dhammesvamhi (syā. ka.)] patiṭṭhito.
segments.thag21.1:4.3: Nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, tattha me nirato mano.
segments.thag21.1:5.3: Tathā maccu karissāmi, na me maggampi dakkhasi.
segments.thag21.1:6.3: Vanathaṃ na kareyya kuhiñci, nibbanatho avanatho sa [nibbanatho arato sa hi (saṃ. ni.1.210)] bhikkhu.
segments.thag21.1:7.3: Parijīyati sabbamaniccaṃ, evaṃ samecca caranti mutattā.
segments.thag21.1:8.1: “Upadhīsu janā gadhitāse, diṭṭhasute [diṭṭhe sute (sī.)] paṭighe ca mute ca;
segments.thag21.1:8.3: Ettha vinodaya chandamanejo, yo hettha na limpati muni tamāhu [taṃ munimāhu (saṃ. ni.1.210)].
segments.thag21.1:9.1: “Atha saṭṭhisitā savitakkā, puthujjanatāya [puthū janatāya (saṃ. ni.1.210)] adhammā niviṭṭhā;
segments.thag21.1:9.3: Na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullagāhī [duṭṭhullabhāṇī (saṃ. ni.1.210)] sa bhikkhu.
segments.thag21.1:10.3: Santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagamā muni, paṭicca parinibbuto kaṅkhati kālaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:12.3: Socanti janā cirarattaṃ, mānahatā nirayaṃ upapannā.
segments.thag21.1:13.1: “Na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammā paṭipanno;
segments.thag21.1:14.1: “Tasmā akhilo idha [akhilo (sī.), akhilodha (saṃ. ni.1.211)] padhānavā, nīvaraṇāni pahāya visuddho;
segments.thag21.1:16.3: Nimittaṃ parivajjehi, subhaṃ rāgūpasaṃhitaṃ ()[(saṅkhāre parato passa, dukkhato mā ca attato; nibbāpehi mahārāgaṃ, mā dayhittho punappunaṃ;)(sī. saṃ. ni.1.212) uddānagāthāyaṃ ekasattatītisaṅkhyā ca, theragāthāṭṭhakathā ca passitabbā].
segments.thag21.1:19.3: Pare ca na vihiṃseyya, sā ve vācā subhāsitā.
segments.thag21.1:20.3: Yaṃ anādāya pāpāni, paresaṃ bhāsate piyaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:21.1: “Saccaṃ ve amatā vācā, esa dhammo sanantano;
segments.thag21.1:21.3: Sacce atthe ca dhamme ca, āhu santo patiṭṭhitā.
segments.thag21.1:24.3: Sālikāyiva nigghoso, paṭibhānaṃ udiyyati [udīrayi (sī.), udīyyati (syā.), udayyati (?) uṭṭhahatīti taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā].
segments.thag21.1:33.3: Sāvako te mahāvīra, pāde vandati vaṅgiso.
segments.thag21.1:34.3: Taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃva bhāgaso pavibhajja.
segments.thag21.1:35.3: Tasmiñca amate akkhāte, dhammadasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā.
segments.thag21.1:36.3: Ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi dasaddhānaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:37.1: “Evaṃ sudesite dhamme, ko pamādo vijānataṃ dhammaṃ;
segments.thag21.1:37.3: Tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassamanusikkhe.
segments.thag21.1:42.3: Cittaṃ nesaṃ samanvesaṃ [samannesaṃ (saṃ. ni.1.218)], vippamuttaṃ nirūpadhiṃ.
segments.thag21.1:44.1: “Cando yathā vigatavalāhake nabhe, virocati vītamalova bhāṇumā;
segments.thag21.1:44.3: Evampi aṅgīrasa tvaṃ mahāmuni, atirocasi yasasā sabbalokaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:45.1: “Kāveyyamattā vicarimha pubbe, gāmā gāmaṃ purā puraṃ;
segments.thag21.1:46.3: Dhammaṃ sutvā pasīdimha, saddhā [addhā (sī. aṭṭha.)] no udapajjatha.
segments.thag21.1:52.1: “Evamete tathā vuttā, diṭṭhā me te yathā tathā;
segments.thag21.1:52.3: Sadattho me anuppatto, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:53.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi, mama buddhassa santike;
segments.thag21.1:53.3: Suvibhattesu [savibhattesu (sī. ka.)] dhammesu, yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tadupāgamiṃ.
segments.thag21.1:55.1: “Pucchāmi satthāramanomapaññaṃ, diṭṭheva dhamme yo vicikicchānaṃ chettā;
segments.thag21.1:55.3: Aggāḷave kālamakāsi bhikkhu, ñāto yasassī abhinibbutatto.
segments.thag21.1:56.1: “Nigrodhakappo iti tassa nāmaṃ, tayā kataṃ bhagavā brāhmaṇassa;
segments.thag21.1:56.3: So taṃ namassaṃ acari mutyapekho, āraddhavīriyo daḷhadhammadassī.
segments.thag21.1:57.1: “Taṃ sāvakaṃ sakka mayampi sabbe, aññātumicchāma samantacakkhu;
segments.thag21.1:57.3: Samavaṭṭhitā no savanāya sotā [hetuṃ (sī. syā.) suttanipātaṭṭhakathā passitabbā], tuvaṃ no satthā tvamanuttarosi”.
segments.thag21.1:58.1: Chinda no vicikicchaṃ brūhi metaṃ, parinibbutaṃ vedaya bhūripañña;
segments.thag21.1:58.3: Majjheva no bhāsa samantacakkhu, sakkova devāna sahassanetto.
segments.thag21.1:59.1: “Ye keci ganthā idha mohamaggā, aññāṇapakkhā vicikicchaṭhānā;
segments.thag21.1:59.3: Tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavanti, cakkhuñhi etaṃ paramaṃ narānaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:60.1: “No ce hi jātu puriso kilese, vāto yathā abbhaghanaṃ vihāne;
segments.thag21.1:60.3: Tamovassa nivuto sabbaloko, jotimantopi na pabhāseyyuṃ [na jotimantopi narā tapeyyuṃ (su. ni.350)].
segments.thag21.1:61.1: “Dhīrā ca pajjotakarā bhavanti, taṃ taṃ ahaṃ vīra tatheva maññe;
segments.thag21.1:61.3: Vipassinaṃ jānamupāgamimha, parisāsu no āvikarohi kappaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:62.1: “Khippaṃ giraṃ eraya vaggu vagguṃ, haṃsova paggayha saṇikaṃ nikūja;
segments.thag21.1:62.3: Bindussarena suvikappitena, sabbeva te ujjugatā suṇoma.
segments.thag21.1:63.1: “Pahīnajātimaraṇaṃ asesaṃ, niggayha dhonaṃ vadessāmi [paṭivediyāmi (sī. ka.)] dhammaṃ;
segments.thag21.1:63.3: Na kāmakāro hi [hoti (sī. ka.)] puthujjanānaṃ, saṅkheyyakāro ca [va (bahūsu)] tathāgatānaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:64.3: Ayamañjali pacchimo suppaṇāmito, mā mohayī jānamanomapañña.
segments.thag21.1:65.3: Vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vācābhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.
segments.thag21.1:66.3: Nibbāyi so ādu saupādiseso [anupādisesā (sī.), anupādiseso (ka.)], yathā vimutto ahu taṃ suṇoma.
segments.thag21.1:67.4: Atāri jātiṃ maraṇaṃ asesaṃ’, iccabravi bhagavā pañcaseṭṭho.
segments.thag21.1:68.3: Amoghaṃ kira me puṭṭhaṃ, na maṃ vañcesi brāhmaṇo.
segments.thag21.1:69.1: “Yathā vādī tathā kārī, ahu buddhassa sāvako;
segments.thag21.1:69.3: Acchecchi maccuno jālaṃ, tataṃ māyāvino daḷhaṃ.
segments.thag21.1:71.5: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā vaṅgīso thero gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
segments.thag21.1:73.1: Sahassaṃ honti tā gāthā, tīṇi saṭṭhisatāni ca;
segments.thag21.1:73.3: Therā ca dve satā saṭṭhi, cattāro ca pakāsitā.
